question:
Evaluate the given expression.

 ((1)/(4))⁽⁻¹/²⁾
solution:
**Given:**

(1/4)⁻¹/²

**Formula used:**

a⁻b = 1 / ab

a⁽m⁾/⁽ⁿ⁾ = sqrt [n](am)

**Calculation:**

⇒ (1/4)⁻¹/² = 1 / (1/4)¹/²

⇒ 1 / √(1/4)

⇒ 1 / (1/2)

⇒ 2

**∴ The value of the given expression is 2.**
